@@ -195,34 +196,38 @@ https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/AudioVideo/Conceptual/

+/* ISO/IEC 13818-1 Table 2-109 */

-#define EXTENSION_DESCRIPTOR         0x7f
+#define DVB_EXTENSION_DESCRIPTOR     0x7f
 
 /* DVB descriptor_tag_extension values from
    ETSI EN 300 468 Table 109: Possible locations of extended descriptors */
 #define SUPPLEMENTARY_AUDIO_DESCRIPTOR 0x06
 
 /** see "Dolby Vision Streams Within the MPEG-2 Transport Stream Format"
 https://professional.dolby.com/siteassets/content-creation/dolby-vision-for-content-creators/dolby-vision-bitstreams-in-mpeg-2-transport-stream-multiplex-v1.2.pdf */
 #define DOVI_VIDEO_STREAM_DESCRIPTOR 0xb0
 
 #define DATA_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTOR 0xfd /* ARIB STD-B10 */

fix_commit_message:
avformat/mpegts: bounds-check JPEG-XS header_size before padding

Regression since: 536475ea05.

The JPEG-XS PES path trusted header_size from the payload and advanced
pkt->data/pkt->size without validation, so the trailing memset could
write out of bounds when header_size > pkt->size. Reject such packets,
marking them corrupt and returning an error to avoid the OOB write.

Repro (ASan):
ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:detect_leaks=0   ./ffmpeg -v debug -nostdin -i poc-jpegxs.ts -copy_unknown -map 0   -c copy -f null /dev/null

Crash in new_pes_packet memset on crafted TS with stream_id 0xbd,
stream_type 0x32, header_size 0xFFFFFF00, payload starting with jxes.

Found-by: Pwno
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 16f89d342ebd on top of intro 536475ea0582 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (BufferOverflow): The JPEG-XS support added to libavformat/mpegts.c's new_pes_packet() function reads a 32-bit header_size field directly from the untrusted PES payload and uses it, unvalidated, to advance pkt->data and decrease pkt->size. Because this value comes straight from attacker-controlled input (a crafted MPEG-TS file), it can be arbitrarily large (e.g. 0xFFFFFF00), causing pkt->size to underflow/become invalid and pkt->data to point beyond the allocated buffer. The subsequent unconditional memset(pkt->data + pkt->size, 0, AV_INPUT_BUFFER_PADDING_SIZE) call, which pads every demuxed packet, then writes out of bounds relative to the actual allocation, corrupting heap memory. Root cause: Missing bounds validation of an attacker-controlled length field (header_size) read from network/file input before it is used in pointer arithmetic that adjusts a buffer's base pointer and size, which are later used to compute a memset destination address.
